description.value: Freddy's Brewing is an in-house craft brewery and full-service brewpub operating inside the McCurdy Bowling Centre, a large entertainment complex in Kelowna. The brewpub pours over 12 in-house craft beers alongside cocktails, wine, and spirits, paired with an elevated pub food menu spanning breakfast through dinner. A touring cyclist stopping here gets a rare combination of serious craft beer and a lively, spacious venue.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM URL (mccurdybowl.com/craftbrewerykelowna) returns a 404, but the parent site mccurdybowl.com was successfully fetched and confirms this is 'Freddy's Brewpub' — an in-house brewery inside the McCurdy Bowling complex at 124-948 McCurdy Rd, Kelowna, BC. The website confirms the business is open and operating, providing the address and two phone numbers not present in OSM. No explicit evidence for bike parking, washrooms, or most amenities appears in the website text.
concerns: OSM website URL (mccurdybowl.com/craftbrewerykelowna) returns a 404; the correct working URL appears to be the parent site mccurdybowl.com. Website field updated to parent URL.
OSM alt_name 'Mill Creek Brewery' does not match the website name 'Freddy's Brewpub' — possible rebrand or OSM data error; the primary OSM name 'Freddy's Brewing' is a partial match only.
Two phone numbers listed on website (Bowl: 250-491-2695; Pub: 250-765-8956); pub number used here, but OSM has no phone to cross-check against.
Address (124-948 McCurdy Rd) is from website only; OSM has no address tag to confirm against.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating brewpub confirmed by website content with address and hours. The 404 on the specific OSM URL is a broken link, not a closed business.
enrichment_extras.notes: The brewery operates inside the McCurdy Bowling complex. The OSM record tags it as craft=brewery but the venue is primarily a brewpub. Both the bowling and pub operations share the same building.
